headline: DevOps Engineer II
profile: AWS-certified DevOps engineer on Vistra's Digital team in Singapore, with a background in full-stack development. Previously ran production-grade Kubernetes at Flight Centre (10+ EKS clusters across 20+ AWS accounts). Works across Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), high-availability cloud networking, CI/CD and observability, and builds AI-augmented development workflows with Claude Code. Outside work, builds and ships products: Burno and Aemantic.

Orchestrated 10+ EKS clusters (30+ nodes) across multi-region environments, consistently maintaining 99.9% uptime
Established Infrastructure-as-Code standards using Terraform for corporate tools including New Relic, Octopus Deploy, GitHub Org, etc
Led ongoing migration of EKS clusters to EKS Auto Mode, streamlining node management and reducing infrastructure maintenance

Leveraged CloudWatch Logs and Splunk for comprehensive debugging, log analysis and testing of applications
